lines.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, אֲשֶׁר קִדְּשָׁנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתָיו וְרָצָה בָנוּ, וְשַׁבַּת קָדְשׁוֹ בְּאַהֲבָה וּבְרָצוֹן הִנְחִילָנוּ, זִכָּרוֹן לְמַעֲשֵׂה בְרֵאשִׁית, כִּי הוּא יוֹם תְּחִלָּה לְמִקְרָאֵי קֹדֶשׁ, זֵכֶר לִיצִיאַת מִצְרָיִם, כִּי בָנוּ בָחַרְתָּ וְאוֹתָנוּ קִדַּשְׁתָּ מִכָּל הָעַמִּים וְשַׁבַּת קָדְשְׁךָ בְּאַהֲבָה וּבְרָצוֹן הִנְחַלְתָּנוּ
lines.tl: Baruch atah Adonai Eloheinu melech ha-olam, asher kid'shanu b'mitzvotav v'ratzah vanu, v'Shabbat kodsho b'ahavah uv'ratzon hinchilanu, zikaron l'ma-asei v'reishit, ki hu yom t'chilah l'mikra-ei kodesh, zeicher litzi-at Mitzrayim, ki vanu vacharta v'otanu kidashta mikol ha-amim v'Shabbat kodsh'cha b'ahavah uv'ratzon hinchaltanu
lines.en: Blessed are You, Adonai our God, King of the Universe, Who sanctified us with His commandments and was pleased with us. And His holy Sabbath, with love and pleasure, He gave us for a heritage, a commemoration of the work of creation. For this day is the first of the days of holy convocations commemorating the exodus from Egypt. For us have You chosen and us have You sanctified from among all the peoples. And Your holy Sabbath with love and pleasure You gave us for a heritage.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.tl: Ki heim chayeinu v'orech yameinu uvahem nehgeh yomam valaylah
lines.en: For they are our life and they lengthen our days, and on them we will meditate day and night.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וְאַהֲבָתְךָ אַל תָּסִיר מִמֶּנּוּ לְעוֹלָמִים
lines.tl: V'ahavatcha al tasir mimenu l'olamim
lines.en: [May] Your love never be removed from us.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אוֹהֵב עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל
lines.tl: Baruch atah Adonai oheiv amo Yisrael
lines.en: Blessed are You, Adonai, Who loves His people Israel.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

prayers.title: Mi Chamocha
prayers.about: Who is like You: from the blessing after the Sh'ma (evening)
prayers.he_src: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Maariv, Blessings of the Shema, First Blessing after Shema (segs 1-2) (The Metsudah siddur, 1981, CC-BY)
check: Starts at 'Mi chamocha'; the Emet ve-emunah lines before it are not included yet (Mishkan T'filah shortens them).
Confirm Mishkan T'filah has 'V'ne-emar: ki fadah...' before the closing blessing.

lines.he: מִי כָמֹכָה בָּאֵלִם יְיָ מִי כָּמֹכָה נֶאְדָּר בַּקֹּדֶשׁ נוֹרָא תְהִלֹּת עֹשֵׂה פֶלֶא
lines.tl: Mi chamochah ba-eilim Adonai mi kamochah nedar bakodesh nora t'hilot osei fele
lines.en: “Who is like You among the mighty, Adonai! Who is like You? [You are] adorned in holiness, awesome in praise, performing wonders”
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: מַלְכוּתְךָ רָאוּ בָנֶיךָ בּוֹקֵעַ יָם לִפְנֵי משֶׁה זֶה אֵלִי עָנוּ וְאָמְרוּ
lines.tl: Malchutcha ra-u vanecha bokei-a yam lifnei Moshe zeh eili anu v'amru
lines.en: Your children beheld Your sovereignty when You divided the sea before Moses.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: יְיָ יִמְלֹךְ לְעֹלָם וָעֶד
lines.tl: Adonai yimloch l'olam va-ed
lines.en: “Adonai will reign forever and ever.”
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וְנֶאֱמַר כִּי־פָדָה יְיָ אֶת יַעֲקֹב וּגְאָלוֹ מִיַּד חָזָק מִמֶּנּוּ
lines.tl: V'ne-emar ki fadah Adonai et Yaakov ug'alo miyad chazak mimenu
lines.en: And it is said, “For Adonai has liberated Jacob and redeemed him from a hand, mightier than his.”
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ גָּאַל יִשְׂרָאֵל
lines.tl: Baruch atah Adonai ga-al Yisrael
lines.en: Blessed are You, Adonai Who has redeemed Israel.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

prayers.title: Ma'ariv Aravim
prayers.about: Who brings on evening: the first blessing before the Sh'ma
prayers.he_src: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Maariv, Blessings of the Shema, First Blessing before Shema (The Metsudah siddur, 1981, CC-BY)
check: Evening text, Metsudah siddur. Confirm Mishkan T'filah wording.

lines.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם אֲשֶׁר בִּדְבָרוֹ מַעֲרִיב עֲרָבִים בְּחָכְמָה פּוֹתֵחַ שְׁעָרִים
lines.tl: Baruch atah Adonai Eloheinu melech ha-olam asher bidvaro ma-ariv aravim b'chochmah poteiach sh'arim
lines.en: Blessed are You, Adonai, our God, King of the Universe, With His word He brings on evenings, with wisdom He opens the gates of heaven
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וּבִתְבוּנָה מְשַׁנֶּה עִתִּים וּמַחֲלִיף אֶת־הַזְּמַנִּים וּמְסַדֵּר אֶת־הַכּוֹכָבִים בְּמִשְׁמְרוֹתֵיהֶם בָּרָקִיעַ כִּרְצוֹנוֹ
lines.tl: Uvitvunah m'shaneh itim umachalif et haz'manim um'sadeir et hakochavim b'mishm'roteihem barakia kirtzono
lines.en: And with understanding changes the times and alternates the seasons, and arranges the stars in their watches, in the sky, according to His will.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: בּוֹרֵא יוֹם וָלָיְלָה גּוֹלֵל אוֹר מִפְּנֵי חשֶׁךְ וְחשֶׁךְ מִפְּנֵי אוֹר
lines.tl: Borei yom valaylah goleil or mip'nei choshech v'choshech mip'nei or
lines.en: He creates day and night, He rolls the light away from before darkness, and darkness from before light
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וּמַעֲבִיר יוֹם וּמֵבִיא לָיְלָה וּמַבְדִּיל בֵּין יוֹם וּבֵין לָיְלָה יְיָ צְבָאוֹת שְׁמוֹ
lines.tl: Uma-avir yom umeivi laylah umavdil bein yom uvein laylah Adonai tz'va-ot sh'mo
lines.en: He causes day to pass and brings night, and separates between day and night; Adonai of Hosts is His Name.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: אֵל חַי וְקַיָּם תָּמִיד יִמְלֹךְ עָלֵינוּ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד
lines.tl: Eil chai v'kayam tamid yimloch aleinu l'olam va-ed
lines.en: The Almighty, [Who is] living and enduring will always reign over us forever and ever.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ הַמַּעֲרִיב עֲרָבִים
lines.tl: Baruch atah Adonai hama-ariv aravim
lines.en: Blessed are You, Adonai, Who brings on evening.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

prayers.title: Hashkiveinu
prayers.about: Lay us down in peace: the evening prayer for protection
prayers.he_src: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Maariv, Blessings of the Shema, Second Blessing after Shema (The Metsudah siddur, 1981, CC-BY)
check: Shabbat evening form (ends 'haporeis sukat shalom'). Does Mishkan T'filah keep 'v'haseir mei-aleinu oyeiv, dever v'cherev v'ra-av v'yagon' and 'v'haseir satan'?
Line 1 English: Metsudah has no period after 'to life'.

lines.he: הַשְׁכִּיבֵנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ לְשָׁלוֹם וְהַעֲמִידֵנוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ לְחַיִּים
lines.tl: Hashkiveinu Adonai Eloheinu l'shalom v'ha-amideinu malkeinu l'chayim
lines.en: Adonai our God; make us lie down in peace, our King, raise us again to life
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וּפְרוֹשׂ עָלֵינוּ סֻכַּת שְׁלוֹמֶךָ וְתַקְּנֵנוּ בְּעֵצָה טוֹבָה מִלְּפָנֶיךָ וְהוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ לְמַעַן שְׁמֶךָ
lines.tl: Uf'ros aleinu sukat sh'lomecha v'tak'neinu b'eitzah tovah mil'fanecha v'hoshi-einu l'ma-an sh'mecha
lines.en: Spread over us the shelter of Your peace, and direct us to better ourselves through Your good counsel; and deliver us for Your Name’s sake.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וְהָגֵן בַּעֲדֵנוּ וְהָסֵר מֵעָלֵינוּ אוֹיֵב דֶּבֶר וְחֶרֶב וְרָעָב וְיָגוֹן
lines.tl: V'hagein ba-adeinu v'haseir mei-aleinu oyeiv dever v'cherev v'ra-av v'yagon
lines.en: Shield us, and remove from us enemies, pestilence, sword, famine and sorrow.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וְהָסֵר שָׂטָן מִלְּפָנֵינוּ וּמֵאַחֲרֵינוּ וּבְצֵל כְּנָפֶיךָ תַּסְתִּירֵנוּ
lines.tl: V'haseir satan mil'faneinu umei-achareinu uv'tzeil k'nafecha tastireinu
lines.en: Remove the adversary from before us and from behind us, and shelter us in the shadow of Your wings.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: כִּי אֵל שׁוֹמְרֵנוּ וּמַצִּילֵנוּ אָתָּה כִּי אֵל מֶלֶךְ חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם אָתָּה
lines.tl: Ki eil shomreinu umatzileinu atah ki eil melech chanun v'rachum atah
lines.en: For, Almighty, You are our Protector and Rescuer, For, Almighty You are a gracious and merciful King.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וּשְׁמוֹר צֵאתֵנוּ וּבוֹאֵנוּ לְחַיִּים וּלְשָׁלוֹם מֵעַתָּה וְעַד עוֹלָם
lines.tl: Ush'mor tzeiteinu uvo-einu l'chayim ul'shalom mei-atah v'ad olam
lines.en: Guard our going out and our coming in for life and peace for now forever.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וּפְרוֹשׂ עָלֵינוּ סֻכַּת שְׁלוֹמֶךָ
lines.tl: Uf'ros aleinu sukat sh'lomecha
lines.en: And spread over us the shelter of Your peace.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ הַפּוֹרֵשׂ סֻכַּת שָׁלוֹם עָלֵינוּ וְעַל כָּל עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל וְעַל יְרוּשָׁלָיִם
lines.tl: Baruch atah Adonai haporeis sukat shalom aleinu v'al kol amo Yisrael v'al Y'rushalayim
lines.en: Blessed are You, Adonai, Who spreads the shelter of peace over us and over all His people, Israel and over Jerusalem.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

prayers.title: V'shamru
prayers.about: Keeping Shabbat: Exodus 31:16-17
prayers.he_src: Exodus 31:16-17 (Miqra according to the Masorah, CC-BY-SA)
check: Torah text (Exodus 31:16-17). English: Contemporary Torah (CC-BY-NC).

lines.he: וְשָׁמְרוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הַשַּׁבָּת לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת־הַשַּׁבָּת לְדֹרֹתָם בְּרִית עוֹלָם
lines.tl: V'shamru v'nei Yisrael et haShabbat la-asot et haShabbat l'dorotam b'rit olam
lines.en: The Israelite people shall keep the sabbath, observing the sabbath throughout the ages as a covenant for all time:
lines.en_src: The Contemporary Torah, Jewish Publication Society, 2006

lines.he: בֵּינִי וּבֵין בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אוֹת הִוא לְעֹלָם כִּי־שֵׁשֶׁת יָמִים עָשָׂה יְיָ אֶת־הַשָּׁמַיִם וְאֶת־הָאָרֶץ וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי שָׁבַת וַיִּנָּפַשׁ
lines.tl: Beini uvein b'nei Yisrael ot hi l'olam ki sheishet yamim asah Adonai et hashamayim v'et ha-aretz uvayom hash'vi-i shavat vayinafash
lines.en: It shall be a sign for all time between Me and the people of Israel. For in six days Adonai made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day [God] ceased from work and was refreshed.
lines.en_src: The Contemporary Torah, Jewish Publication Society, 2006

prayers.title: Avot v'Imahot
prayers.about: Our ancestors: the first blessing of the Amidah
prayers.he_src: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Maariv, Amidah, Patriarchs (The Metsudah siddur, 1981, CC-BY)

lines.he: אֲדֹנָי שְׂפָתַי תִּפְתָּח וּפִי יַגִּיד תְּהִלָּתֶךָ
lines.tl: Adonai s'fatai tiftach ufi yagid t'hilatecha
lines.en: My Master, open my lips, and my mouth will declare Your praise.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ וְאִמּוֹתֵינוּ
lines.tl: Baruch atah Adonai Eloheinu v'Elohei avoteinu v'imoteinu
lines.en: Blessed are You, Adonai, our God, and God of our fathers
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם אֱלֹהֵי יִצְחָק וֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב אֱלֹהֵי שָׂרָה אֱלֹהֵי רִבְקָה אֱלֹהֵי רָחֵל וֵאלֹהֵי לֵאָה
lines.tl: Elohei Avraham Elohei Yitzchak v'Elohei Yaakov Elohei Sarah Elohei Rivkah Elohei Rachel v'Elohei Leah
lines.en: God of Abraham, God of Isaac, and God of Jacob
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981
reform: Adds Elohei Sarah, Elohei Rivkah, Elohei Rachel v'Elohei Leah.

lines.he: הָאֵל הַגָּדוֹל הַגִּבּוֹר וְהַנּוֹרָא אֵל עֶלְיוֹן גּוֹמֵל חֲסָדִים טוֹבִים וְקוֹנֵה הַכֹּל
lines.tl: Ha-eil hagadol hagibor v'hanora eil elyon gomeil chasadim tovim v'konei hakol
lines.en: The Almighty, the Great, the Powerful, the Awesome, most high Almighty, Who bestows beneficent kindness, Who possesses everything
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וְזוֹכֵר חַסְדֵי אָבוֹת וְאִמָּהוֹת וּמֵבִיא גְאֻלָּה לִבְנֵי בְנֵיהֶם לְמַעַן שְׁמוֹ בְּאַהֲבָה
lines.tl: V'zocheir chasdei avot v'imahot umeivi g'ulah livnei v'neihem l'ma-an sh'mo b'ahavah
lines.en: Who remembers the piety of the Patriarchs, and Who brings a redeemer to their children’s children, for the sake of His Name, with love.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: מֶלֶךְ עוֹזֵר וּמוֹשִׁיעַ וּמָגֵן
lines.tl: Melech ozeir umoshia umagein
lines.en: King, Helper, and Deliverer and Shield.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ מָגֵן אַבְרָהָם וְעֶזְרַת שָׂרָה
lines.tl: Baruch atah Adonai magein Avraham v'ezrat Sarah
lines.en: Blessed are You, Adonai, Shield of Abraham.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

prayers.title: G'vurot
prayers.about: God's power: the second blessing of the Amidah
prayers.he_src: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Maariv, Amidah, Divine Might (The Metsudah siddur, 1981, CC-BY)

lines.he: אַתָּה גִבּוֹר לְעוֹלָם אֲדֹנָי מְחַיֵּה הַכֹּל אַתָּה רַב לְהוֹשִׁיעַ
lines.tl: Atah gibor l'olam Adonai m'chayeih hakol atah rav l'hoshia
lines.en: You are mighty forever, my Master; You are the Resurrector of the dead the Powerful One to deliver us.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981
reform: M'chayeih hakol (gives life to all) instead of m'chayeh meitim (revives the dead).

lines.he: מַשִּׁיב הָרוּחַ וּמוֹרִיד הַגֶּשֶׁם
lines.tl: Mashiv haruach umorid hageshem
lines.en: Causer of the wind to blow and of the rain to fall.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: מוֹרִיד הַטָּל
lines.tl: Morid hatal
lines.en: He causes the dew to descend.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: מְכַלְכֵּל חַיִּים בְּחֶסֶד מְחַיֵּה הַכֹּל בְּרַחֲמִים רַבִּים
lines.tl: M'chalkeil chayim b'chesed m'chayeih hakol b'rachamim rabim
lines.en: Sustainer of the living with kindliness, Resurrector of the dead with great mercy
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981
reform: M'chayeih hakol instead of m'chayeih meitim.

lines.he: סוֹמֵךְ נוֹפְלִים וְרוֹפֵא חוֹלִים וּמַתִּיר אֲסוּרִים וּמְקַיֵּם אֱמוּנָתוֹ לִישֵׁנֵי עָפָר
lines.tl: Someich noflim v'rofei cholim umatir asurim um'kayeim emunato lisheinei afar
lines.en: Supporter of the fallen, and Healer of the sick, and Releaser of the imprisoned, and Fulfiller of His faithfulness to those who sleep in the dust.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: מִי כָמוֹךָ בַּעַל גְּבוּרוֹת וּמִי דּוֹמֶה לָּךְ מֶלֶךְ מֵמִית וּמְחַיֶּה וּמַצְמִיחַ יְשׁוּעָה
lines.tl: Mi chamocha ba-al g'vurot umi domeh lach melech meimit um'chayeh umatzmiach y'shu-ah
lines.en: Who is like You, Master of mighty deeds, and who can be compared to You? King Who causes death and restores life, and causes deliverance to sprout forth.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וְנֶאֱמָן אַתָּה לְהַחֲיוֹת הַכֹּל
lines.tl: V'ne-eman atah l'hachayot hakol
lines.en: And You are faithful to restore the dead to life.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981
reform: L'hachayot hakol instead of l'hachayot meitim.

lines.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ מְחַיֵּה הַכֹּל
lines.tl: Baruch atah Adonai m'chayeih hakol
lines.en: Blessed are You, Adonai, Resurrector of the dead.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981
reform: M'chayeih hakol instead of m'chayeih hameitim.

prayers.title: K'dushat HaShem
prayers.about: God's holiness: the third blessing of the Amidah (evening)
prayers.he_src: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Maariv, Amidah, Holines of God's Name (The Metsudah siddur, 1981, CC-BY)
check: Evening form (no K'dushah). Ten Days ending (hamelech hakadosh) left out.

lines.he: אַתָּה קָדוֹשׁ וְשִׁמְךָ קָדוֹשׁ וּקְדוֹשִׁים בְּכָל־יוֹם יְהַלְלוּךָ סֶּלָה
lines.tl: Atah kadosh v'shimcha kadosh uk'doshim b'chol yom y'hal'lucha selah
lines.en: You are holy and Your Name is holy and holy beings praise You every day, forever.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ הָאֵל הַקָּדוֹשׁ
lines.tl: Baruch atah Adonai ha-eil hakadosh
lines.en: Blessed are You, Adonai, the Almighty, the Holy One.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

prayers.title: K'dushat HaYom
prayers.about: The holiness of Shabbat: R'tzei vimnuchateinu (evening)
prayers.he_src: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Maariv, Amidah, Sanctity of the Day (The Metsudah siddur, 1981, CC-BY)
check: Only R'tzei vimnuchateinu is here. Does Mishkan T'filah's Shabbat evening K'dushat HaYom also have Atah kidashta, Vay'chulu, or Yism'chu?
Line 1, Reform change: Adds v'imoteinu (and our mothers). Confirm against Mishkan T'filah.

lines.he: אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ וְאִמּוֹתֵינוּ רְצֵה בִמְנוּחָתֵנוּ
lines.tl: Eloheinu v'Elohei avoteinu v'imoteinu r'tzei vimnuchateinu
lines.en: Our God, and God of our fathers, be pleased with our rest
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: קַדְּשֵׁנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתֶיךָ וְתֵן חֶלְקֵנוּ בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ שַׂבְּעֵנוּ מִטּוּבֶךָ
lines.tl: Kad'sheinu b'mitzvotecha v'tein chelkeinu b'toratecha sab'einu mituvecha
lines.en: Sanctify us with Your commandments and give us our share in Your Torah; satisfy us from Your goodness
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וְשַׂמְּחֵנוּ בִּישׁוּעָתֶךָ, וְטַהֵר לִבֵּנוּ לְעָבְדְּךָ בֶּאֱמֶת
lines.tl: V'sam'cheinu bishu-atecha, v'taheir libeinu l'avd'cha be-emet
lines.en: And gladden us with Your deliverance, and purify our hearts to serve You in truth.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וְהַנְחִילֵנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּאַהֲבָה וּבְרָצוֹן שַׁבַּת קָדְשֶׁךָ
lines.tl: V'hanchileinu Adonai Eloheinu b'ahavah uv'ratzon Shabbat kodshecha
lines.en: And give us as our inheritance, Adonai our God, in love and in pleasure Your holy Shabbat
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וְיָנוּחוּ בָהּ יִשְׂרָאֵל מְקַדְּשֵׁי שְׁמֶךָ
lines.tl: V'yanuchu vah Yisrael m'kad'shei sh'mecha
lines.en: And may Israel rest thereon— the sanctifiers of Your Name.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ מְקַדֵּשׁ הַשַּׁבָּת
lines.tl: Baruch atah Adonai m'kadeish haShabbat
lines.en: Blessed are You Adonai, Sanctifier of Shabbat.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

prayers.title: Shalom Rav
prayers.about: Abundant peace: the last blessing of the Amidah (evening)
prayers.he_src: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Maariv, Amidah, Peace (The Metsudah siddur, 1981, CC-BY)
check: Does Mishkan T'filah's Shalom Rav add 'v'al kol yoshvei teiveil' (and all who live on earth)?
Ten Days insert (B'sefer chayim) left out. Ending: ham'vareich et amo Yisrael bashalom.

lines.he: שָׁלוֹם רָב עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמְּךָ תָּשִׂים לְעוֹלָם
lines.tl: Shalom rav al Yisrael am'cha tasim l'olam
lines.en: Bestow abundant peace upon Israel, Your people, forever.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: כִּי אַתָּה הוּא מֶלֶךְ אָדוֹן לְכָל־הַשָּׁלוֹם
lines.tl: Ki atah hu melech adon l'chol hashalom
lines.en: For You are King, the Master of all peace.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וְטוֹב בְּעֵינֶיךָ לְבָרֵךְ אֶת־עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּכָל־עֵת וּבְכָל־שָׁעָה בִּשְׁלוֹמֶךָ
lines.tl: V'tov b'einecha l'vareich et am'cha Yisrael b'chol eit uv'chol sha-ah bishlomecha
lines.en: And may it be good in Your sight to bless us and to bless Your people Israel, at all times and at every moment with Your peace.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ הַמְבָרֵךְ אֶת־עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּשָּׁלוֹם
lines.tl: Baruch atah Adonai ham'vareich et amo Yisrael bashalom
lines.en: Blessed are You, Adonai, Who blesses His people Israel with peace.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

prayers.title: Vay'chulu
prayers.about: Genesis 2:1-3: heaven and earth completed, and the seventh day
prayers.he_src: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Maariv, Vay'chulu (The Metsudah siddur, 1981, CC-BY)
check: Torah text (Genesis 2:1-3), as printed in the Metsudah siddur. Mishkan T'filah also has it in the Kiddush; same wording?
Does CBB say Vay'chulu after the Amidah, or only in Kiddush?

lines.he: וַיְכֻלּוּ הַשָּׁמַיִם וְהָאָרֶץ וְכָל־צְבָאָם
lines.tl: Vay'chulu hashamayim v'ha-aretz v'chol tz'va-am
lines.en: And the heavens and the earth were completed and [so were] all their hosts.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וַיְכַל אֱלֹהִים בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי מְלַאכְתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה, וַיִּשְׁבֹּת בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי מִכָּל־מְלַאכְתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה
lines.tl: Vay'chal Elohim bayom hash'vi-i m'lachto asher asah, vayishbot bayom hash'vi-i mikol m'lachto asher asah
lines.en: And God completed by the seventh day His work which He had done, and He abstained on the seventh day, from all His work which He had done.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וַיְבָרֶךְ אֱלֹהִים אֶת־יוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וַיְקַדֵּשׁ אֹתוֹ, כִּי בוֹ שָׁבַת מִכָּל־מְלַאכְתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר־בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים לַעֲשׂוֹת
lines.tl: Vay'varech Elohim et yom hash'vi-i vay'kadeish oto, ki vo shavat mikol m'lachto asher bara Elohim la-asot
lines.en: And God blessed the seventh day and sanctified it for on it He abstained from all His work which God had created to do.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

prayers.title: Magen Avot
prayers.about: The Amidah in brief, said together after it (from Me'ein Sheva)
prayers.he_src: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Maariv, Me'ein Sheva (The Metsudah siddur, 1981, CC-BY)
check: Only the Magen Avot paragraph of Me'ein Sheva is here (not the opening 'Baruch atah... koneih shamayim va-aretz' or the closing R'tzei). Does Mishkan T'filah print more?
Ten Days word (hamelech hakadosh) left out.
English is Metsudah's 'Resurrector of the dead' and 'fathers'; it doesn't match hakol or v'imahot.
Line 1, Reform change: Adds v'imahot: Magen avot v'imahot (shield of fathers and mothers). Confirm against Mishkan T'filah.
Line 1, Reform change: M'chayeih hakol instead of m'chayeih meitim. Confirm against Mishkan T'filah.

lines.he: מָגֵן אָבוֹת וְאִמָּהוֹת בִּדְבָרוֹ, מְחַיֵּה הַכֹּל בְּמַאֲמָרוֹ
lines.tl: Magein avot v'imahot bidvaro, m'chayeih hakol b'ma-amaro
lines.en: Shield of [our] fathers with His word, Resurrector of the dead with His utterance
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981
reform: Adds v'imahot: Magen avot v'imahot (shield of fathers and mothers).
M'chayeih hakol instead of m'chayeih meitim.

lines.he: הָאֵל הַקָּדוֹשׁ שֶׁאֵין כָּמוֹהוּ, הַמֵּנִיחַ לְעַמּוֹ בְּיוֹם שַׁבַּת קָדְשׁוֹ, כִּי בָם רָצָה לְהָנִיחַ לָהֶם
lines.tl: Ha-eil hakadosh she-ein kamohu, hameiniach l'amo b'yom Shabbat kodsho, ki vam ratzah l'haniach lahem
lines.en: The Almighty, the Holy One Who has no peer. He gives rest to His people on the day of His holy Shabbat for with them He was pleased to grant them rest.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: לְפָנָיו נַעֲבוֹד בְּיִרְאָה וָפַחַד, וְנוֹדֶה לִשְׁמוֹ בְּכָל יוֹם תָּמִיד מֵעֵין הַבְּרָכוֹת
lines.tl: L'fanav na-avod b'yir'ah vafachad, v'nodeh lishmo b'chol yom tamid mei-ein hab'rachot
lines.en: Before Him we will serve with fear and trepidation, and give thanks to His Name every day continuously, from the essence of the blessings.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: אֵל הַהוֹדָאוֹת, אֲדוֹן הַשָּׁלוֹם, מְקַדֵּשׁ הַשַּׁבָּת וּמְבָרֵךְ שְׁבִיעִי, וּמֵנִיחַ בִּקְדֻשָּׁה לְעַם מְדֻשְּׁנֵי עֹנֶג זֵכֶר לְמַעֲשֵׂה בְרֵאשִׁית
lines.tl: Eil hahoda-ot, adon hashalom, m'kadeish haShabbat um'vareich sh'vi-i, umeiniach bikdushah l'am m'dush'nei oneg zeicher l'ma-asei v'reishit
lines.en: Almighty of thanksgiving, Master of peace, Sanctifier of the Shabbat, Who blesses the seventh day and grants rest in sanctity to a people sated with delight— in commemoration of the work of creation.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

prayers.title: Aleinu
prayers.about: Our duty to praise: the closing prayer
prayers.he_src: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Maariv, Aleinu (The Metsudah siddur, 1981, CC-BY)
check: Does Mishkan T'filah offer the alternative first paragraph ('shenatan lanu torat emet, v'chayei olam nata b'tocheinu') in place of 'shelo asanu k'goyei ha-aratzot...'? Which does CBB sing?
The second paragraph (Al kein n'kaveh) is left out; only its closing V'ne-emar line is here. Does Mishkan T'filah or CBB include Al kein?
'Hu Eloheinu ein od... v'yadata hayom' (lines 6-7) kept from the traditional text. Confirm Mishkan T'filah prints them.
Line 4, Reform change: Leaves out 'shehem mishtachavim lahevel varik umitpal'lim el el lo yoshia' (many traditional Ashkenazi siddurim also omit it). Confirm against Mishkan T'filah.

lines.he: עָלֵינוּ לְשַׁבֵּחַ לַאֲדוֹן הַכֹּל לָתֵת גְּדֻלָּה לְיוֹצֵר בְּרֵאשִׁית
lines.tl: Aleinu l'shabeiach la-adon hakol lateit g'dulah l'yotzeir b'reishit
lines.en: It is our obligation to praise the Master of all, to ascribe greatness to the Creator of the [world in the] beginning
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: שֶׁלֹּא עָשָׂנוּ כְּגוֹיֵי הָאֲרָצוֹת וְלֹא שָׂמָנוּ כְּמִשְׁפְּחוֹת הָאֲדָמָה
lines.tl: Shelo asanu k'goyei ha-aratzot v'lo samanu k'mishp'chot ha-adamah
lines.en: That He has not made us like the nations of the lands, and has not positioned us like the families of the earth
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: שֶׁלֹּא שָׂם חֶלְקֵנוּ כָּהֶם וְגוֹרָלֵנוּ כְּכָל הֲמוֹנָם
lines.tl: Shelo sam chelkeinu kahem v'goraleinu k'chol hamonam
lines.en: That He has not assigned our portion like theirs, nor our lot like that of all their multitudes.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וַאֲנַחְנוּ כּוֹרְעִים וּמִשְׁתַּחֲוִים וּמוֹדִים לִפְנֵי מֶלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּלָכִים הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא
lines.tl: Va-anachnu kor'im umishtachavim umodim lifnei melech malchei ham'lachim hakadosh baruch hu
lines.en: But we bow, prostrate ourselves, and offer thanks before the Supreme King of Kings, the Holy One blessed is He
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981
reform: Leaves out 'shehem mishtachavim lahevel varik umitpal'lim el el lo yoshia' (many traditional Ashkenazi siddurim also omit it).

lines.he: שֶׁהוּא נוֹטֶה שָׁמַיִם וְיוֹסֵד אָרֶץ, וּמוֹשַׁב יְקָרוֹ בַּשָּׁמַיִם מִמַּעַל, וּשְׁכִינַת עֻזּוֹ בְּגָבְהֵי מְרוֹמִים
lines.tl: Shehu noteh shamayim v'yoseid aretz, umoshav y'karo bashamayim mima-al, ush'chinat uzo b'govhei m'romim
lines.en: Who spreads the heavens, and establishes the earth, and the seat of His glory is in heaven above, and the abode of His invincible might is in the loftiest heights.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: הוּא אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֵין עוֹד, אֱמֶת מַלְכֵּנוּ אֶפֶס זוּלָתוֹ כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתוֹ
lines.tl: Hu Eloheinu ein od, emet malkeinu efes zulato kakatuv b'torato
lines.en: He is our God, there is nothing else. Our King is true, all else is insignificant, as it is written in His Torah
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וְיָדַעְתָּ הַיּוֹם וַהֲשֵׁבֹתָ אֶל לְבָבֶךָ כִּי יְיָ הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים בַּשָּׁמַיִם מִמַּעַל וְעַל הָאָרֶץ מִתָּחַת אֵין עוֹד
lines.tl: V'yadata hayom vahasheivota el l'vavecha ki Adonai hu ha-Elohim bashamayim mima-al v'al ha-aretz mitachat ein od
lines.en: And You shall know this day and take into Your heart that Adonai is God in the heavens above and upon the earth below; there is nothing else.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וְנֶאֱמַר וְהָיָה יְיָ לְמֶלֶךְ עַל כָּל הָאָרֶץ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יִהְיֶה יְיָ אֶחָד וּשְׁמוֹ אֶחָד
lines.tl: V'ne-emar v'hayah Adonai l'melech al kol ha-aretz bayom hahu yihyeh Adonai echad ush'mo echad
lines.en: And it is said: And Adonai will be King over the whole earth; on that day Adonai will be One and His Name One.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981
